Bases, tables and records in the Airtable workspaces a token can reach.

## API key

1. Open [airtable.com](https://airtable.com/create/tokens) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** A personal access token from airtable.com/create/tokens, limited to the scopes and bases the app needs.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add airtable
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  airtable: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Airtable's [API](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/introduction) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show airtable` shows the key as set.

**Rate limits:** 5 calls a second. 5 requests per second per base; 50 per second across all of one user's personal access tokens.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Airtable).
